text: 金溢科技公告，公司拟以现金2160万元收购山东高速信联支付有限公司12%的股权。本次交易完成后，公司持有信联支付的股权将由23.00%增加至35.00%，信联支付仍为公司的参股公司，不纳入公司合并报表范围。信联支付为受中国人民银行监管的第三方支付机构，本次交易尚需经过中国人民银行审查通过，股权交割时间存在不确定性。
text_en: Jinyi Technology announced that the company plans to acquire a 12% equity stake in Shandong Hi-Speed Xinlian Payment Co., Ltd. for 21.6 million yuan in cash. After the transaction is completed, the company's equity stake in Xinlian Payment will increase from 23.00% to 35.00%. Xinlian Payment will remain an associate company of the company and will not be included in the company's consolidated financial statements. Xinlian Payment is a third-party payment institution regulated by the People's Bank of China. The transaction is still subject to approval by the PBOC, and the timing of equity delivery is uncertain.
